summary: ØRSTED A/S (LEI W9NG6WMZIYEU8VEDOG48, DK CVR 36213728) is identifier-confirmed and registered in Denmark. The Danish state is a reported significant shareholder: Wikidata (indicative, sourced from the 2019 annual report) records the Ministry of Finance of Denmark at approximately 50.1%, Andel Energy at approximately 7.28%, and Goldman Sachs at approximately 13.0% and Capital Group Companies at approximately 6.0%, while OpenSanctions separately records shareholdings by the Ministry of Finance on behalf of the Kingdom of Denmark, Equinor ASA, and Andel; all ownership figures are indicative and not drawn from an authoritative register. GLEIF Level 2 data confirms ØRSTED A/S as the accounting consolidating parent of a large international subsidiary network spanning Denmark, the UK, the US, and Taiwan, while the ultimate parent relationship carries a GLEIF reporting exception — the parent does not consolidate the subject — leaving the top of the ownership chain unresolved. Three structural risk signals were identified by GLEIF (medium confidence): an anonymous entity in the ownership chain (opaque ownership), a corporate structure of three or more layers meeting the AMLA threshold for complex layering, and an advisory possible-obfuscation signal (low confidence) combining opacity with complex layering, which requires confirmation of a legitimate economic rationale before reliance. Additionally, OpenAleph name-match signals (medium confidence, unconfirmed — no shared birth date or nationality) were raised against nine related parties — including directors Lene Skole-Sørensen (formand), Andrew Richard Dingley Brown (næstformand), Trond Ødegård Westlie (direktør), Rasmus Errboe (adm. dir.), and board members Julia Elizabeth King, Karl Johnny Hersvik, Julian David Waldron, Benny Gøbel, and Ruchit Majmudar — via the Denmark, Faroe Islands and Greenland PEPs dataset; none of these constitute confirmed PEP identifications and each requires individual verification. A material licensing limitation applies: OpenSanctions data is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0 and may not be commercially re-used without separate authorisation.
